title: Clean Baby Blender Blush Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora

What it is: A specialized dome-shaped blending brush that distributes color seamlessly without streaking—the perfect match for Baby Cheeks Blush Stick (sold separately).


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Sustainable Hardwood Birch: Sourced from a Forest Stewardship Council certified forest in Eastern Europe

- Cruelty-free Nylon Fibers: Optimal density, softness and function for ultra smooth application

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Blend Baby Cheeks Blush Stick (sold separately) into skin, using small circles or tiny buffing strokes for the most natural flush.
-This brush can also be used to mix multiple shades for a unique, customized color.
-Use the brush to soften and blend Face Trace Contour Stick (sold separately) into skin.
-Gently clean your brush with mild soap and water.

Gucci Westman's tip:
-"I played around with Baby Blender's exact size and shape until I found the precise dimensions for a perfect blush application."—Gucci Westman, Westman Atelier founder
Ingredients+

- Sustainable Hardwood Birch: Sourced from a Forest Stewardship Council certified forest in Eastern Europe

- Cruelty-free Nylon Fibers: Optimal density, softness and function for ultra smooth application


Artisan Design: Handmade in Kumano, Japan using traditional techniques from the most prestigious brush maker in the world.


Lacquered Handles: Crafted with the finest sustainable hardwood birch from a Forest Stewardship Council certified forest in Eastern Europe.


High Performance: Luxurious and durable. Cruelty-free nylon fibers feel ultra-smooth with optimal density, softness and function. Our brush-making process is cruelty-free.



The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
